findings.finding: A logistic-regression MIA on the statistics of ACTUALLY TRANSMITTED uplink bases is statistically indistinguishable from chance (0.5) at every tau (accuracy 0.4625-0.4792, all p >= 0.1188, 30 trials).
findings.evidence: EXP8_DF recorded table; Wilson CIs [0.4005, 0.5422] all contain 0.5
findings.interpretation: Under this threat model the uplink channel shows no detectable membership leakage; wording bounded accordingly.
findings.limitation: One attack family, one scene, one fixed member split; non-significance is not proof of absence.

findings.finding: Proxy A (COIL-20 held-out objects, local basis statistics) is borderline: 30-split accuracy 0.559 +/- 0.029 with t-test p < 0.001 but Wilson 95% CI [0.392, 0.726] containing 0.5.
findings.interpretation: Weak evidence of leakage for an attacker with access to LOCAL basis statistics; the t-test and the Wilson interval are different estimands and are reported side-by-side. [REQUIRES CONFIRMATION] for paper wording.
findings.limitation: Proxy attacks on local statistics, not on intercepted traffic; COIL-20 objects are visually similar.

findings.finding: Proxy B (content-shift diagnostic dino-vs-temple) reaches 87.5% test accuracy, confirming the attack pipeline is sensitive when a genuine content difference exists.
findings.interpretation: The chance-level result on transmitted bases reflects the channel, not a broken attacker.
findings.limitation: Diagnostic only; not a membership attack in the strict sense.

findings.finding: Gaussian DP noise on uploaded bases trades utility for privacy across sigma in [0, 0.15]; SSIM/BRF degrade as sigma grows (10-trial statistics per variant).
findings.evidence: stat_dp_tradeoff.csv + legacy DP panel (values not printed inline in the recorded run)
findings.interpretation: Quantifies the cost of the DP defence; exact table values [REQUIRES CONFIRMATION] from the CSV.
findings.limitation: Noise applied to the global dictionary post hoc, not to per-round uploads; no formal (epsilon, delta) DP guarantee.

4/4 tau values statistically indistinguishable from chance (p>=0.05) -- no detectable membership leakage on intercepted bases
